comparison.objective: Regrasp a dropped terminal block through an in-air handover into its mounting grip; candidate breaks and collects insert tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual handover, reorientation, and mounting-grip placement versus one-arm mandrel stabilization, other-arm hammering, withdrawal, and fragment search.
comparison.success_condition: Terminal block restored to its mounting grip; no specs or pose thresholds provided. Candidate requires four physical fractures, complete containment, and no coil or shell damage.
comparison.reason: Both use bimanual coordination, but the tested abilities and outcomes—regrasp/reorientation versus controlled fracture and debris recovery—are materially different.
